filo find [DIR] [--name PATTERN] [--tag TAG]... [--no-tag TAG]... [-0]
          [--no-scan] [--workers N]

  Lists the files under DIR, a directory inside a root, or under every root,
  whose name matches PATTERN and whose tags match every --tag and no --no-tag;
  with neither, every file. Scans first, so a file saved since the last scan is
  found. Lists the files present now: not missing files, files deleted by filo
  or symlinks. A file with hard links is listed once.

  In a terminal, every file found, with its modified date, size and tags. Piped,
  one absolute path per line, escaped as all output is (a name holding a newline
  or a backslash is shown escaped, says so on stderr and exits 1); use -0 to
  pass any name to xargs -0 or tar --null -T -.

Flags
  --name PATTERN           the file's name, not its directory, ignoring case; *
                           matches any run of characters, and is the only
                           wildcard (? and [ match themselves)
  --tag TAG                a tag the file has (repeatable: all of them):
                           key:value, key: for any value of the key, or a bare
                           value; * in a value matches any run of characters,
                           and case is ignored
  --no-tag TAG             a tag the file lacks (repeatable): --no-tag sender:
                           lists the files with no sender
  -0                       piped only: the paths as they are, each ended by a
                           NUL, for xargs -0
  --no-scan                skip the scan: list from the register as it is
  --workers N              for the scan: files hashed in parallel, 1-64 (default
                           4; use 1 on a spinning disk)
